blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-verified on 2026-10-01 at Ethereum block 26098754. The exact verified MetaMorpho source and 40 bundled dependencies retain ordinary ERC-20 share transfers without a holder blacklist, freeze, pause, allowlist or mutable transfer gate. The EIP-1967 implementation, admin and beacon slots are zero; owner() remains 0xc684c6587712e5e7bdf9fd64415f23bd2b05faec. Local share-transfer permissions are distinct from Circle's issuer-side powers over the USDC supplied to Morpho markets. The inherited classification therefore remains, with no claim that parent USDC is unfreezable.
